items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: That was before he made, Dave O'Tonim went back there and was looking for Tyler and got him.

ctx.x: Memphis Lewis. He did. How long did Thatch Domino play with you? I wanted to ask you that too. I forgot about that.

That was before he made, Dave O'Tonim went back there and was looking for Tyler and got him. He was playing back at the Hideaway. That was before Dave went back there and got him and he made that, he recorded that record about, his first recording was Junko Padna. Mm-hmm. His first recording. Well that was before he made the recording. He was going down the night, you know, he was playing back at the Hideaway, Friday, Saturday, then Sunday. That's where Dave went back there and got him, man. Mm-hmm. Got him back…
Well was he a band piano player or a solo? Band piano player or a solo? No. No.
